officialApp.name: Kokoon
officialApp.notes: MyKokoon: sleep audio library, audio fade-out into coloured noise, EEG-based sleep insights and coaching. Subscription after trial.

battery.chargingIndicators: LED above the power button: green >75%, amber <75%, red low; charging LED green; micro-USB.
battery.notes: Single 500 mAh battery in the headband, so one combined reading. No charging case; 11 h is the figure given by Kokoon's CEO and reviews, not a spec-table number. Later units/reviews report around 13 h.

anc.notes: Active noise cancellation plus passive isolation and active white noise. No transparency mode documented.

features.name: Ear-cup EEG sleep and relaxation tracking
features.notes: EEG electrodes in both ear cups plus an accelerometer.

features.name: Sleep detection with audio fade-out
features.notes: Fades the current audio and introduces coloured noise when sleep is detected.

features.name: Active noise cancellation
features.notes: Toggled with the power button; LED turns purple when on.

features.name: 3.5 mm wired input
features.notes: Passive/ANC listening with the included cable.

controls.physicalButtons: Power/ANC button above left ear cup; multi-function action button on the right

audio.notes: 40 mm 32 Ω dynamic drivers. Bluetooth 4.0 Low Energy; 3.5 mm cable included. Reconnects to the two most recent devices but does not stream two at once.

gaps: Official current spec page no longer lists battery, Bluetooth version or weight.
ANC depth and transparency support not published.
Exact EQ/custom audio controls in the app not documented.
Whether current production still uses micro-USB is not stated on the official page.
notes: Over-ear sleep headphone with EEG. The current Kokoon shop page focuses on sleep/relaxation and does not publish a full spec sheet; hardware details come from launch-era documentation and reviews.

officialApp.name: Kokoon
officialApp.notes: Sleep sensing, audio fade-out, sound library, sleep score and coaching.

battery.chargingIndicators: LED on the neck control unit; USB-C charging.
battery.notes: One 100 mAh battery in the neck control unit, so a single combined reading. No charging case; official/retail spec is 10+ h.

anc.notes: No ANC. Passive silicone-tip isolation plus dynamic noise masking with coloured noise.

features.name: Sleep sensing with auto pause/fade-out
features.notes: In-ear optical heart-rate/HRV sensor plus motion sensing; fades audio into coloured noise.

features.name: Voice-call microphone
features.notes: Control-unit microphone; call handling via the multi-function button.

features.name: Battery-saving auto power-off
features.notes: Pauses audio and powers off when removed.

controls.physicalButtons: MFB, volume + and volume - on the neck control unit
controls.notes: Wired buds to a behind-neck control module; not true wireless.

audio.notes: Balanced-armature drivers; Bluetooth 5.0, HFP/A2DP/AVRCP; IPX2. 100 mAh battery, USB-C.

featureDeltaFromPrevious: In-ear sleep-sensing buds instead of over-ear EEG
gaps: Kokoon does not publish a current battery/charging spec table.
Codec list limited to SBC by retail documentation.
Whether the app subscription is still required for sleep insights is not stated on the product page.
notes: In-ear sleep headphones on a neck cable, launched 2022. Positioned below the Relax and without ANC.
